prior_inspection: V5 component table and unrounded component means/standard errors were inspected before this diagnostic was specified. This is not preregistered.
method: whole-root bootstrap; fixed-sample-SE maximum across eight component means; project simultaneous rectangle onto nonnegative roots of a+p*b=0
ratio_estimand: ratio of population mean components; not mean root ratio
zero_denominator: report undefined point ratio; confidence projection may be unbounded or empty; no bootstrap draws discarded
secondary_ratio_summary: untrimmed pointwise percentile ratios only when all resampled denominators have the observed sign; otherwise omit the percentile interval and record instability counts
coverage_scope: approximate simultaneous eight-component family conditional on frozen synthetic population, separate from original24 and diagnostic64; no joint coverage across analyses
